chat.answer:
Based on my analysis, Santiago is a computer engineering student at the University of La Rioja, specialising in knowledge management, and he is aiming to become a machine learning and MLOps engineer. He is currently an intern at Encore Lab, building a secure cloud platform with LLM features.

He approaches problems empirically: rather than assuming which solution is best, he measures it, whether that means comparing five CNN architectures or benchmarking a VP-tree index against brute-force search. He cares about the details that make a system reliable, not just functional.

He grew up in Quito, studied at a French lycée and now lives in Spain, so he adapts quickly and works comfortably in Spanish, English and French.
